result.protocol_symptom_hint: scoreboard/compare-style failures are frequently a SYMPTOM of a lower-level bus-protocol problem, not the root cause. Before reading RTL line-by-line or inspecting the waveform by hand, run sweep_handshakes once: it checks the protocol health of every bus interface (AHB + AXI/valid-ready) in a single call and returns a per-interface stall/deadlock/payload-hold fact table. Drill into one interface with suggest_protocol_bundles/suggest_handshakes + inspect_handshake only if you need to.
